entry.title: Why I Chose English for My Content

link.title: Why I Chose English for My Content

entry.summary: Before I made my first video, the hardest decision wasn’t about gear, software, or editing. It was something much simpler and much more annoying: which language should I create content in? The obvious answer was Slovenian. It’s my mother tongue, and when you’re just starting out, going after your home market first feels like the safe move. But Slovenia is small — and small means limited reach....
